description: Implementation of the f1u_local_connector class managing F1-U bearer creation, attachment, disconnection, and removal for CU and DU in a 5G network context.

classes.name: f1u_local_connector
classes.description: Class managing F1-U bearer lifecycle and transport layer connections in a 5G network.

methods.name: create_cu_bearer
methods.description: Creates and registers a new CU gateway bearer with specified parameters.

methods.name: attach_dl_teid
methods.description: Connects UL and DL GTP tunnels by attaching CU and DU bearers.

methods.name: disconnect_cu_bearer
methods.description: Disconnects and removes a CU bearer based on UL GTP tunnel info.

methods.name: create_du_bearer
methods.description: Creates and registers a DU bearer associated with a CU bearer.

methods.name: remove_du_bearer
methods.description: Removes a DU bearer based on DL GTP tunnel info.
